operation.description:
Adds a repository to the list of selected repositories that are enabled for GitHub Actions in an organization. To use this endpoint, the organization permission policy for `enabled_repositories` must be must be configured to `selected`. For more information, see "[Set GitHub Actions permissions for an organization](#set-github-actions-permissions-for-an-organization)."

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Enable a selected repository for GitHub Actions in an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/parameters/repository-id.description: The unique identifier of the repository.
#/components/parameters/repository-id.name: repository_id
